audit_result.proof_trace: Go map iteration order is randomized by language spec. Lines 79-82 build cellsIndices by iterating sidecarByIndex map without sorting, passing unsorted indices to RecoverCellsAndKZGProofs (line 86). The c-kzg-4844 library requires sorted indices (verified by test at fulu__kzg__recover_cells_and_kzg_proofs_test.go:45-57 which expects failure for unsorted input).
audit_result.attack_scenario: Attacker sends valid DataColumnSidecars via P2P. Node's reconstruction randomly orders cell indices due to map iteration, causing RecoverCellsAndKZGProofs to fail or produce incorrect recovery results, breaking PeerDAS reconstruction.

PROP-57888860-inv-006.text: Recovery cell_indices must be unique and sorted in ascending order.

audit_result.proof_trace: VerifyDataColumnSidecar checks len(kzg_commitments) > 0 and length consistency, but does NOT validate len(kzg_commitments) <= MaxBlobsPerBlock(epoch). Nodes accept oversized data column sidecars violating the blob schedule limit (6/9/12 depending on epoch).
audit_result.attack_scenario: Attacker gossips data column sidecar with 100 KzG commitments exceeding max_blobs_per_block. Nodes process and store invalid oversized columns, causing memory/CPU exhaustion and potential DoS.

PROP-6a4369e9-inv-009.text: kzg_commitments count must not exceed max_blobs_per_block for the sidecar's epoch.

audit_result.proof_trace: Config loader accepts fork epochs from YAML without validating strict ordering (Genesis < Altair < ... < Fulu). The merge() function silently sorts entries by epoch, allowing semantically invalid configs where fork version enums become decoupled from their intended epochs, potentially causing consensus failures in testnets/devnets.
audit_result.attack_scenario: Misconfigured testnet YAML defines BELLATRIX_FORK_EPOCH < ALTAIR_FORK_EPOCH. Config loads successfully, schedule is epoch-sorted, but version-to-epoch mappings become incorrect, causing nodes to apply wrong fork rules at specific epochs and diverge from correctly-configured peers.

PROP-6a4369e9-inv-014.text: Fork epoch constants must be strictly ordered: GENESIS < ALTAIR < ... < ELECTRA < FULU.

audit_result.proof_trace: Self-peer bypass at L37-38 accepts own messages without any REJECT checks. Local validator's data columns skip all 12 gossip requirements (field validity, KZG proofs, proposer signature, inclusion proofs, etc.) and return ValidationAccept immediately.
audit_result.attack_scenario: Compromised local validator or malicious modification of validator client can broadcast invalid data columns (wrong KZG proofs, invalid signatures, incorrect subnets) which are auto-accepted by own node, bypassing all consensus validation. These invalid sidecars propagate to forkchoice/storage before detection.

PROP-6a4369e9-post-002.text: After gossip validation acceptance, sidecar must have passed all REJECT checks in order.

audit_result.proof_trace: Handler lacks epoch-based deprecation guard. No rejection when current_epoch >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS (4096). Handler remains registered in Fulu fork map (rpc.go:52) and continues serving requests indefinitely as long as data is in retention window.
audit_result.attack_scenario: After FULU_FORK_EPOCH + 4096 epochs, peers send blob_sidecars_by_root requests for recent blobs. Node serves them normally instead of rejecting, delaying PeerDAS migration and enabling resource exhaustion via legacy RPC paths.

PROP-6a4369e9-inv-035.text: blob_sidecars_by_root must be fully deprecated after FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS.
